subject: Security acceptance checklist & retention commitments (post-demo follow-up)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@northspirebank.com>, security@northspirebank.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security acceptance checklist & retention commitments (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Maya / Northspire security team —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth from our call:

High-level objectives you shared:
- Short term: validate audit-log availability and retention settings for our hosted API to meet internal compliance and upcoming internal audit (Q4).
- Medium term: SOC 2 alignment for data flows touching logs and metadata; confirm DPA language on retention limits and subprocessor list.
- Risk tolerance: strict retention for audit logs (90 days immutable, 12 months searchable) and ability to extract trace artifacts on request.

Primary pain points we surfaced:
- Lack of clear retention SLA and export playbook for audit traces.
- Need for pre-approved pen-test window and evidence handoff process.
- DDQ gaps around encryption key custody and long-term DPA redlines.

What Redwood will provide (deliverables):
1) Retention matrix (attached: redwood-retention-matrix-NSB.xlsx) — maps log types (audit, request, infra) to retention windows and export format. Owner: me (Irene). ETA: 48 hours.
2) Pen-test window proposal (attached: pen-test-window-proposal.pdf) — proposed test windows, scope, and expected evidence artifacts. Owner: Vivek Kulkarni. ETA: 3 business days.
3) Draft DPA with explicit retention clause & subprocessor list (attached draft: dpa-draft-nsbank.docx). Owner: Jordan Blake. ETA: EOW for initial comments.
4) SOC 2 evidence catalog (cloud logs, access reviews, change control screenshots) — we will enumerate and provide export packages or read-only links as needed. Owner: Redwood security/ops (cc'd). ETA: 1 week for initial mapping.

Immediate asks for your team:
- Confirm whether the retention windows in the attached matrix align with your audit requirements (specifically immutable vs. searchable windows).
- Share preferred pen-test vendor constraints and blackout dates — you mentioned outside vendor approval may be required.
- Loop in your internal legal contact if you want to accelerate DPA redline.

Next scheduled items:
- I’ve added a follow-up check-in for Tue Aug 17 at 10:00am PT pending your availability (I’ll send a calendar invite once Maya confirms).

Attachments: redwood-retention-matrix-NSB.xlsx (spreadsheet), pen-test-window-proposal.pdf (PDF), dpa-draft-nsbank.docx (Word)

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Solutions Lead, Enterprise Sales (Security)
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

---
Note: On the call were: Maya Singh (Northspire), Tom W. (introduced as external auditor), and Simon Patel from Northspire architecture (not copied here).

From: Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@northspirebank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@northspirebank.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 16:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security acceptance checklist & retention commitments (post-demo follow-up)

Thanks, Irene — this is super helpful and captures the discussion. A couple clarifications from our side:

- The audit group will want immutable retention for critical audit logs at 180 days minimum; searchable/nearline for 12 months is acceptable for request logs. Can you flag which row in the retention matrix maps to "critical audit logs"?
- For pen tests: our InfoSec policy requires the vendor to be ISO 27001 certified and to provide an ATO form. Tom Whitaker (cc'd in my note to you separately) is our external auditor and will want to review the proposed window.

I’ve attached our internal DDQ for your intake — it has a few narrow asks around KMS controls and backup encryption that we typically validate during SOC 2 readiness.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood can provide a timestamped export (CSV + SHA256 sum) of the audit log within 48hrs of a request? That’s a key control for our auditors.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Head of Security Operations
Northspire Bank
maya.singh@northspirebank.com | +1 (212) 555-0124

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@northspirebank.com>, security@northspirebank.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security acceptance checklist & retention commitments (post-demo follow-up)

Maya — thanks for the DDQ and the questions. Short answers below; I’ve pasted your questions inline for clarity.

> The audit group will want immutable retention for critical audit logs at 180 days minimum; searchable/nearline for 12 months is acceptable for request logs. Can you flag which row in the retention matrix maps to "critical audit logs"?

On Aug 15, 2027, at 2:05 PM, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Attachments: redwood-retention-matrix-NSB.xlsx ...

Answer: "Critical audit logs" correspond to the "auth / admin audit" row in the matrix (tab: "LOG_TYPES"). We will update that row to show immutable retention = 180 days and searchable = 12 months per your ask. Iren e will push an updated matrix today.

> Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a timestamped export (CSV + SHA256 sum) of the audit log within 48hrs of a request?

Answer: Yes — Redwood can produce an export package (CSV + gz) and a SHA256 checksum within 48 hours for supported accounts. This is provided as part of Dedicated and Private customers by default; for Hosted customers we offer export options via a supported SR with higher SLAs or via dedicated capacity plans. We will include the exact export template and an example SHA256 manifest in the updated evidence catalog.

> For pen tests: our InfoSec policy requires the vendor to be ISO 27001 certified and to provide an ATO form.

Answer: We are ISO-aligned for core controls and can provide our certification record and ATO checklist for review. Vivek — can you attach the pen-test proposal and call out where we accept ISO 27001 vendor constraints?

Next steps we commit to:
- Irene: revised retention matrix with explicit "auth / admin audit" row updated (ETA: same day).
- Vivek: pen-test window + note on vendor constraints and certs (ETA: 2 business days).
- Jordan: send DPA draft to legal gate with suggested retention clause and a tracked-redline for Northspire review (ETA: EOW).

We also propose an evidence-handoff playbook for audit requests (export ticket, signed receipt, checksum) — I’ll share a one-page playbook in the follow-up.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

From: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@auditpartners.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@northspirebank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security acceptance checklist & retention commitments (post-demo follow-up)

Jordan / team — thanks for the rapid follow-up. I reviewed the proposed approach and the initial answers look good. A couple minor asks before we mark acceptance for the audit:

- Please include an example export with SHA256 manifest (sanitized sample is fine) in the evidence catalog.
- Confirm whether immutable retention for the "auth / admin audit" row is enforced by WORM or by access controls (we prefer WORM-backed storage for the immutable window).

If both are present (sample export + confirmation of WORM-backed enforcement), we can sign off on the retention portion and proceed to schedule the pen-test window.

I’ll coordinate with Maya on scheduling once we see the updated matrix and the pen-test constraints.

Thanks —
Tom Whitaker
Principal Auditor, AuditPartners
tom.whitaker@auditpartners.io | +1 (617) 555-0789
